Endeavor Hero Agency.text: The agency of Endeavor (Enji Todoroki), the Number Two hero at the start of the year, run from a tower in central Tokyo. Endeavor holds the record for the most incidents resolved in Japan's history, and the agency is built for volume: dozens of sidekicks on rotating shifts, an operations floor that tracks incidents across the city in real time, and a training gym where everyone is expected to keep pace. Sidekicks such as Burnin, Kido and Onima work in his shadow and know that his standards do not bend. The public respects his results and does not much like him: he ignores fans, refuses interviews he considers pointless and treats second place as an insult. The visible contradiction: the country's most effective hero is also one of its least loved.
